vocab.definition: the number of protons in an atom.
the total number of protons and neutrons.
atoms of the same element with different numbers of neutrons.
a charged atom formed by losing or gaining electrons.

misconceptions.wrong: Atoms always have equal protons and neutrons.
misconceptions.right: Neutron number often differs from proton number.
Isotopes react the same — they share electron arrangement.

misconceptions.wrong: The mass number is the mass in grams.
misconceptions.right: It is just the count of protons + neutrons.

infoPanels.title: STRUCTURE OF THE ATOM
infoPanels.secondaryContent: A tiny nucleus of protons and neutrons is surrounded by electrons in shells.

questions.secondaryText: When an atom ______ electrons it becomes a ______ ion.

questions.text: Chlorine is 75% ³⁵Cl and 25% ³⁷Cl. Calculate its relative atomic mass. [2 marks]

footer.tip: Protons + neutrons sit in the nucleus; electrons orbit in shells.
